name: Cerebras Inference
description: Serves open-weight LLMs such as Qwen and GPT OSS through an OpenAI-compatible API on wafer-scale hardware, for developers who need very fast inference.

skills.name: Tool Calling
skills.description: Connects models to external tools, with strict mode constraining tool-call arguments to a supported JSON Schema subset.

skills.name: Structured Outputs
skills.description: Constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process the generated data reliably.

skills.name: Batch Inference
skills.description: Runs large-scale inference workloads asynchronously from uploaded JSONL request files, with create, list, and cancel endpoints.

skills.name: Prompt Caching
skills.description: Stores and reuses previously processed prompts to cut latency on similar or repeated queries.
